MAIN HOUSE / INDIVIDUALLY VENTED FIXTURE CONCEPT
Design slope ¼″ per foot on horizontal drainage and sewer. Confirm fall to verified inverts.
Connect DW-1 through a listed dishwasher air gap to the sink tailpiece upstream of the trap.
KS-1 carries the combined load. WM-1 discharges into a trapped, vented 2″ standpipe per CPC
DFU basis assumes private-use gravity-tank WCs at 1.6 gpf or less and a single showerhead per
assembly. Verify retained fixtures, final outlets and actual water-heater discharges.
Proposed listed ABS DWV for new sanitary branches subject to approved transitions. Select
underground piping after confirming existing lateral material and utility requirements.
Keep trap arms within CPC Table 1002.2. Rise before offsetting or joining per §905.3. Coordinate
roof terminals, opening clearances per §906, and vent sizing and aggregate area per §§703.2 and
Provide accessible cleanouts at building drain exits (CO) and as required by CPC §§707 and 719.
Size sewer and vents after measuring developed lengths and confirming the lateral and invert
2025 California Plumbing Code, with Ventura Municipal Code Ch. 12.120. Drainage loads from CPC
Table 702.1. City Building & Safety checklist BS-007, page 4.
